name: mastra-evals
description: Designs and generates a complete evaluation system for any Mastra AI agent or workflow — scorers (code-based, LLM-as-judge, rubric), golden datasets, offline experiments, CI regression via runEvals, online scoring with sampling, and eval tests. Battle-tested against @mastra/core 1.45 / @mastra/evals 1.4. Includes a brainstorming entry point for broad/vague goals.
